props.description:
When you first take this Skill, you gain a Hex Clock with 4 sections. The Clock starts each scene empty. When you perform an attack with an arcane weapon or cast an offensive (⚡) spell, you may spend 10 Hit Points to fill one section of your Hex Clock.

At the start of your turn, you may spend up to [5 × the number of filled sections of your Hex Clock] Mind Points. For every 5 Mind Points spent this way, deal [SL × 2] Dark or Poison damage to a creature you can see. You may choose a different creature for each instance of damage.
props.name: Encroaching Hex

props.description:
You cause the target’s condition to worsen into a debilitating infection. The target recovers from one of the following (choose one if it has both):

  • Weak
  • Shaken

and it becomes Poisoned.
props.name: Plague

props.description:
You briefly connect the threads of life between two creatures, allowing one to transfer a portion of their vitality to the other. Either target may spend up to 50 Hit Points. The other creature recovers an equal amount of Hit Points.

Additionally, until this spell ends, the creature who recovered Hit Points this way gains a +2 bonus to Checks using MIG that aren’t Accuracy Checks or Magic Checks.
props.name: Transfer Life

props.description: When your group journeys on the world map, you will make a discovery when the travel die rolls its maximum result (6 on a d6, on a d8, etc.). You still encounter a danger, as normal.
props.name: Where Evil Treads

props.description: You draw sickness away from an ally and pass it onto your enemy. The target recovers from all status effects. Then choose one of the status effects the target recovered from and another creature you can see. The chosen creature suffers the chosen status effect.

0.menu_subtitle: Choose another creature you can see
0.menu_title: Symptom Shift — pass the sickness to?

1.menu_subtitle: These status effects move to the chosen creature

props.name: Symptom Shift

props.description:
You may perform rituals whose effects fall within the Spiritism discipline. Spiritism rituals use [INS + WLP] for the Magic Check.

Additionally, you may use Spiritism to locate the sources of illnesses and curses.
props.name: Curse Ritualism

props.description:
When you take the Hinder action and succeed on your Check, the target and each other enemy that has at least one status effect in common with it takes [SL × 5] Dark or Poison damage (your choice).

You gain a bonus equal to [SL] on Checks made as part of the Hinder action.
props.name: Fell Resonance

props.description:
You cover the target’s eyes with pitch-black shadows, blocking their sight. Until the spell ends, the target suffers a −2 penalty to Accuracy Checks.

This spell has no effect on creatures that do not rely on sight. An effect that can remove a status effect can end this effect instead.
props.name: Blind

props.description: When an action you take causes one or more creatures to suffer a status effect, an additional creature of your choice suffers the same status effect.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered the Hexer Class.
props.name: Contagion

props.description:
You hurl a globule of caustic muck that splatters on impact. A target hit by this spell takes [HR+15] Poison.

Whether the spell hits or misses, up to two creatures other than the initial target each take 5 Poison damage.
props.name: Acid Splash

props.description:
You place a mark on the target’s soul that weakens their ability to resist afflictions and ailments. The target suffers your choice of:

  • Slow
  • Dazed
  • Weak
  • Shaken

Until this spell ends, if an effect would cause the target to recover from one or more status effects, you choose one of those status effects for the target to keep. Once that happens, this spell ends. If the target becomes immune to a status effect, they still recover as normal.
props.name: Deteriorate

props.description:
Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Hexer spell (see the Facet).

Offensive (⚡) Hexer spells use [INS + WLP] for the Magic Check.
props.name: Curse Magic

props.description:
You magnify the target’s distress into blinding rage. The target recovers from one of the following (choose one if it has both):

  • Slow
  • Dazed

and it becomes Enraged.
props.name: Seething Blight

props.description:
You conjure troubling visions in the target’s mind, wearing down their focus. Until the spell ends, the target suffers a −2 penalty to Magic Checks.

An effect that can remove a status effect can end this effect instead.
props.name: Muddle

props.description:
You open a rift filled with malice, dread, and disease, condemning those pulled into it to overwhelming darkness. Choose one option:

  • One creature you can see suffers 50 Poison damage and becomes poisoned

  • You choose any number of creatures you can see, and each of them suffers 30 Dark damage and cannot choose any of the other chosen creatures as targets for effects this round.

This spell ignores damage Resistances and Immunities, as well as condition immunities.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― This damage increase by 5

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― This damage increase by 10
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered the Hexer Class.
props.name: Abyss

props.description: You conjure an oppressive atmosphere that amplifies strain on the target’s mind. The next time a target hit by this spell would spend Mind Points, that creature must spend an additional 10 Mind Points or lose their intended effect.
props.name: Pressure

props.description:
You imbue a weapon with poisonous energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes of the Poison type. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action.

This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
props.name: Venomous Weapon

props.description:
Light bends around your ally to keep them hidden from danger. Until this spell ends, the target cannot be selected as a target for an attack or offensive spell that has multiple targets.

Additionally, until this spell ends, the target gains a +2 bonus to Checks that involve remaining hidden or moving undetected.
props.name: Shadow Mask

effects.description: Aura of Decay: any creature that makes a melee attack against the bearer takes 10 Poison damage, hit or miss.
effects.name: Aura of Decay

props.description:
You cloak the target in a veil of magic that is toxic to enemies. Until this spell ends, any creature that performs a melee attack against the target takes 10 Poison damage. The attacker takes this damage even if the attack misses.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― This damage becomes 15 Poison.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― This damage becomes 20 Poison.
props.name: Aura of Decay

props.description:
When you deal Poison or Dark damage and it reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, each other enemy takes 10 Poison damage, which can cause this Heroic Skill to trigger again.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― This damage becomes 15 Poison.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― This damage becomes 20 Poison.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered the Hexer Class.
props.name: Lethal Dosage

props.class_lore:
Hexers are powerful spellcasters who harness the darkest facets of magic. They specialize in curses and toxins, weaving spells that use biting poison, blinding shadows, and malevolent charms to wear their foes down and render them vulnerable.

Many of the Hexer’s most potent abilities take some setup to prepare, requiring time or assistance from allies to perform the necessary steps. Once the pieces are in place, though, a Hexer’s dark magic is truly fearsome.
